purpose: test whether the same nominal DOWN/SIDEWAYS/UP state has comparable temporal meaning across carrier interval and phase before any calibration decision

fixed_measurement.reason: X3 first tests temporal semantics of the unchanged V1 candidate; sensitivity cannot replace the fixed baseline

metrics.state_episode_duration: consecutive completed-profile bars in the exact same DOWN/SIDEWAYS/UP state
metrics.one_step_transition_matrix: P(next state | current state) over available consecutive profile observations
metrics.directional_survival_h: for an origin in UP or DOWN, all next 1..h states must remain in the same directional family; SIDEWAYS breaks survival but is not counted as opposite-direction reversal
metrics.opposite_direction_entry_h: for an origin in UP or DOWN, whether the opposite directional state appears at least once within the next h profile bars; intervening SIDEWAYS is allowed

comparison_plan.cross_interval_caveat: a bar horizon is profile-relative and not equal wall-clock time across intervals; report interval results separately and do not treat h=5 as the same elapsed time for 1m and 60m

forbidden: BUY SELL position order route semantics
changing V1 T1 or lookback during X3
promoting legacy exact views to runtime admission
claiming universal temporal semantics from two carriers
next_after_x3: combine X2 distribution evidence and X3 temporal-semantics evidence for a provisional calibration-family decision; universal claims still require X5 cross-carrier expansion
